article.title: Correlation Can Be Useful Even When It Is Not Causation
article.why: Build practical English through analytical and business reasoning.
article.author: OpenAI learning brief

paragraphs.en: “Correlation is not causation” is one of the most repeated warnings in data analysis. It is important, but it is sometimes used too aggressively. Two variables moving together does not prove that one causes the other, yet the relationship can still be useful. Correlation can reveal patterns worth investigating, improve prediction, identify unusual behavior, and help teams form better hypotheses. The mistake is not observing correlation. The mistake is giving it a causal interpretation without enough evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 「相關不等於因果」是資料分析最常見的警語之一。它很重要，但有時被用得太過頭。兩個變數一起變動不能證明其中一個造成另一個，但這個關係仍可能有用。相關性可以揭示值得調查的模式、改善預測、找出異常行為並幫助形成假設。錯誤不在於觀察相關，而在於證據不足時把它解讀成因果。
paragraphs.ja: 「相関は因果ではない」は重要な警告だが、使いすぎることもある。二変数が一緒に動いても一方が他方を引き起こしたとは証明できない。しかし相関は調査すべきパターンを示し、予測を改善し、異常を見つけ、仮説形成を助ける。問題は相関を見ることではなく、十分な証拠なしに因果と解釈することだ。

paragraphs.en: Consider customers who use a mobile payment service more often and also spend more at a retailer. Several explanations are possible. Using the service might increase convenience and encourage purchases. Heavy shoppers might simply be more likely to adopt the service. A promotion could simultaneously increase both usage and spending. Age, income, store access, or digital familiarity could influence both. The observed correlation is therefore a starting point that creates questions rather than an answer that closes the investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 行動支付使用越頻繁的顧客，也可能在零售商消費更多。原因可能很多：服務提升便利性進而促進購買；本來就是重度消費者的人更可能採用服務；促銷同時推升使用與消費；年齡、收入、門店可及性或數位熟悉度也可能同時影響兩者。因此相關性是產生問題的起點，而不是結束調查的答案。
paragraphs.ja: モバイル決済をよく使う顧客ほど支出も多い場合、決済が利便性を高めた可能性も、元々のヘビーユーザーが採用しやすい可能性もある。キャンペーンや年齢、所得、店舗アクセス、デジタル慣れが両方へ影響することもある。相関は調査を終える答えではなく、問いを生む出発点である。

paragraphs.en: For prediction, causality may not even be the immediate objective. A weather forecast system can use variables that reliably move with future demand without claiming that every input causes the demand. A fraud model may exploit patterns that are predictive but not causal mechanisms. What matters is whether the relationship remains stable when the model is used. This is why temporal validation, drift monitoring, and operational checks matter: a correlation that disappears in production has little predictive value regardless of its statistical significance in historical data.
paragraphs.zh: 預測任務甚至不一定以因果為直接目標。需求預測可以使用與未來需求穩定共變的變數，而不宣稱每個輸入都造成需求；詐欺模型也可能利用有預測力但不是因果機制的模式。重點是模型使用時關係是否仍穩定，因此時間驗證、漂移監控與營運檢查很重要。
paragraphs.ja: 予測では因果が直接目的でないこともある。需要予測は、各入力が需要を引き起こすと主張せず、将来需要と安定して動く変数を使える。不正検知も因果機構ではない予測パターンを利用し得る。重要なのは運用時にも関係が安定することであり、時系列検証やドリフト監視が必要になる。

paragraphs.en: The standard becomes stricter when the question is an intervention: “If we change X, will Y change?” Here a predictive association is insufficient because acting on X may not reproduce the historical relationship. Randomized experiments are powerful when feasible. Natural experiments, instrumental variables, matching, regression adjustment, and careful causal designs can sometimes help when randomization is unavailable, but each method depends on assumptions. Analysts should make those assumptions explicit rather than hiding them behind sophisticated terminology.
paragraphs.zh: 問題が「Xを変えればYも変わるか」という介入になると基準は厳しくなる。予測上の関連だけでは、Xを操作したとき過去の関係が再現される保証はない。可能なら無作為実験が強力で、難しい場合は自然実験、操作変数、マッチング、回帰調整などが役立つこともあるが、どれも仮定に依存する。

paragraphs.en: A productive workflow therefore has stages. First, use descriptive analysis to find relationships. Second, ask what mechanisms could generate them and what alternative explanations exist. Third, decide whether the business needs prediction or a causal decision. Fourth, choose evidence appropriate to that question. This prevents two opposite errors: treating every correlation as causal, and dismissing every correlation as useless. Good analysis keeps the relationship, the claim, and the decision aligned.
paragraphs.zh: 實用流程可以分階段：先用描述分析找關係，再思考可能機制與替代解釋；接著判斷商業問題需要的是預測還是因果決策，最後選擇適合的證據。如此可避免兩個極端：把所有相關都當因果，或把所有相關都視為無用。好的分析會讓關係、主張與決策保持一致。
paragraphs.ja: 実務では、まず記述分析で関係を見つけ、次に機構と代替説明を考える。その後、必要なのが予測か因果判断かを決め、問いに合う証拠を選ぶ。すべての相関を因果とする誤りと、すべての相関を無価値とする誤りの両方を避けられる。
